name: redeemid/health
title: Shopify Health
description: An at-a-glance checklist of what RedeemID needs: Blockstudio, its blocks, permalinks, the callback page, Shopify sign-in, which wp-config constants are set (never their values) and Shopify's own plugin. Shown to administrators only, in a Blockstudio dynamic island, so a cached page never carries it. Themes add rows with the redeemid_health_checks filter.
